title: oncall-handoff-emily-kim-2026-02-28
content:
Shift summary (2026-02-28 08:00-16:00 PST)
Owner: Emily Kim (eng-sre)

High-level: Quiet start to the shift, one elevated incident (INC-7891) involving degraded response times on hosted-api region us-west-2 between ~09:15-10:05. Temporary mitigation applied (route traffic to secondary pool + increase burst capacity). Systems currently stable but follow-up items remain.

Active incidents / status:
- INC-7891: hosted-api us-west-2 slow median p95 latency spike
  - Impact: API clients experienced 2-4s extra latency for ~50% of requests; errors did not (mostly) increase.
  - Root cause (likely): autoscaler misconfiguration combined with a faulty kernel selection for a new model variant introduced yesterday. Autoscaler did not spin up nodes fast enough under an unusual sequence-length distribution.
  - Temporary mitigation applied at 09:22: updated routing policy to send traffic to dedicated pool (us-west-2-b) and increased burst_capacity to +30%.
  - Current status: monitoring shows latency back to baseline since 09:48. Will keep incident open for postmortem.
  - Follow-ups / owners: Priya to lead postmortem + kernel selection audit (JIRA-INC-7891). Alex to validate autoscaler config and add a stress test for seq-length distribution.

Other notes:
- Cache warmup: we saw a cold cache effect after the routing change; prefix cache warmed within ~12 minutes. No further action required but note for postmortem.
- Minor alert: node ssd-12 reported a transient filesystem warning at 11:20, system recovered after ephemeral reprovision; SRE ticket filed for observation (CONFLUENCE-1245).

Temporary procedures applied (write down so next shift knows what I did):
1) Routing change (applied via admin console): switched route rule "us-west-2-primary" -> "us-west-2-b" at 09:22.
2) Increased burst capacity: edited pool config to burst_capacity = +30% (console -> Dedicated pools -> us-west-2-primary -> Edit).
3) Restarted inference-orchestrator on node group us-west-2-primary-rr (rolling restart) to ensure KV cache consistency. Restart command sequence used: sudo systemctl restart inference-orchestrator; watched logs (journalctl -u inference-orchestrator -f) until stable replica count returned.

If you need to rollback the temporary mitigation (do this only if postmortem determines it is unnecessary):
- Revert routing rule via console to point back to us-west-2-primary. Confirm pool capacity and health (console health page) and that KV cache hit rate recovers within 10-15 minutes.
- Revert burst_capacity to previous setting (baseline +5%).

Runbook pointers / quick commands:
- Check API latency dashboards: Console -> Observability -> Per-route -> hosted-api (filter: region=us-west-2).
- Tail inference logs: ssh to controller node; sudo journalctl -u inference-orchestrator -n 200 -f.
- Check autoscaler status: /opt/bin/autoscaler status --pool us-west-2-primary (requires infra key).
- Force a controlled node add: /opt/bin/autoscaler scale --pool us-west-2-primary --add 2 (only after conferring with infra lead).

Escalation contacts (order):
1) On-call SRE lead: Alex Rivera - pager: +1-415-555-0142 - slack: @alexr
2) Infra eng on-call: Mateo Cruz - pager: +1-415-555-0175 - slack: @mateo
3) Product/Serving runtime: Dr. Lin (model infra) - email: lin@redwood.ai - slack: @dr_lin

Checklist for next shift (things I expect someone to check):
- [ ] Confirm INC-7891 has been added to the postmortem board and assigned. (Priya)
- [ ] Verify the autoscaler stress test PR lands and run it against staging. (Alex)
- [ ] Monitor latency for another 12 hours and annotate any regressions.
- [ ] Check node ssd-12 for recurring filesystem warnings.
- [ ] Do not revert routing until postmortem completes unless latency returns to baseline and infra approves.

Notes / loose ideas (scratchpad):
- We should add a synthetic load test that replicates the unusual sequence-length distribution we saw (long tail of 2048 tokens). Add to workload-generation repo.
- Consider making cache warmup asynchronous and prioritized for hot prefixes after a routing change.

Known quirks / gotchas for this shift (for the next on-caller):
- Admin console changes are eventually consistent; give routing changes ~90s before expecting metrics to reflect new pools.
- autoscaler CLI requires infra key; use bastion jump-host.
- When restarting inference-orchestrator, expect a temporary 1-2 minute increase in p50 latency as replicas rebalance.

Actions I took before handoff (timestamped):
- 09:22 AM: routed traffic to us-west-2-b, increased burst capacity +30%.
- 09:28 AM: started rolling restart of orchestrator on us-west-2-primary.
- 10:00 AM: confirmed p95 back to normal, kept monitoring.
- 11:25 AM: filed observation ticket for node ssd-12 and added slack notes to #oncall.

Next on-call: assigned to Jordan (starts 16:00 PST). Ping me on slack (@emilyk) if anything looks off in the first 30 minutes.

Preserve this doc as a working note (will move to Confluence post-postmortem). If anything critical happens after I sign off I'll update this doc with final timestamps.

-- Emily
